profile.summaryJa: ユダ王アハズの時代に、主はアラム王レツィンとイスラエル王ペカをユダに向かわせました。

facts.textJa: レツィンとペカはエルサレムを攻めましたが、町を攻略できませんでした。
レツィンはエラトを奪い、ユダの人々を追い出しました。
アッシリア王はダマスカスを占領して住民をキルへ移し、レツィンを殺しました。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: In those days, the LORD began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and live there to this day.
The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.
